models.name: xero__invoice_line_items
models.description: Each record represents an invoice line item, enriched with account, contact and invoice information.

columns.name: account_code
columns.description: Customer defined alpha numeric account code e.g 200 or SALES

columns.name: line_item_description
columns.description: The description of the line item

columns.name: discount_rate
columns.description: Percentage discount being applied to a line item.

columns.name: invoice_id
columns.description: The Xero identifier for the invoice the line items belongs to.

columns.name: line_amount
columns.description: The line amount reflects the discounted price if a DiscountRate has been used.

columns.name: line_item_id
columns.description: Xero identifier for the line item.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: The quantity of the line item.

columns.name: tax_amount
columns.description: The tax amount is auto calculated as a percentage of the line amount based on the tax rate.

columns.name: tax_type
columns.description: Used as an override if the default Tax Code for the selected AccountCode is not correct.

columns.name: unit_amount
columns.description: The unit amount of each line item.

columns.name: invoice_date
columns.description: The date the invoice was issued.

columns.name: updated_date
columns.description: The date the invoice was last modified.

columns.name: due_date
columns.description: The date the invoice is/was due.

columns.name: fully_paid_on_date
columns.description: The date the invoice was fully paid. Only returned on fully paid invoices

columns.name: currency_code
columns.description: The currency that invoice has been raised in

columns.name: currency_rate
columns.description: The currency rate for a multicurrency invoice

columns.name: invoice_number
columns.description: Alpha numeric code identifying invoice

columns.name: is_sent_to_contact
columns.description: Boolean to indicate whether the invoice in the Xero app displays as "sent"

columns.name: invoice_status
columns.description: The status of the invoice

columns.name: type
columns.description: The type of the invoice.

columns.name: invoice_reference
columns.description: Additional reference number. For accounts receivable only.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: The Xero identifier for the related account.

columns.name: account_name
columns.description: The name of the account.

columns.name: account_type
columns.description: The type of account, e.g. CURRENT, EQUITY, SALES

columns.name: account_class
columns.description: The class of account, e.g. ASSET, EQUITY, EXPENSE, LIABILITY, REVENUE

columns.name: contact_name
columns.description: The name of the associated contact.

models.name: xero__general_ledger
models.description: Each record represents a journal line item. This ledger is used to create the balance sheet and profit and loss.

columns.name: journal_id
columns.description: Xero identifier for the journal entry

columns.name: created_date_utc
columns.description: The created date of the journal entry

columns.name: journal_date
columns.description: The date the journal was posted

columns.name: journal_number
columns.description: Xero generated journal number

columns.name: reference
columns.description: The associated reference to the journal, if present.

columns.name: source_id
columns.description: The identifier for the source transaction. This can be used to join to other Xero tables.

columns.name: source_type
columns.description: The journal source type. This can be used to know which table to join to for additional information.

columns.name: journal_line_id
columns.description: Xero identifier for the journal line.

columns.name: account_code
columns.description: Customer defined alpha numeric account code e.g 200 or SALES

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: The Xero identifier for the related account.

columns.name: account_name
columns.description: The name of the related account.

columns.name: account_type
columns.description: The type of the related account.

columns.name: gross_amount
columns.description: Gross amount of journal line (NetAmount + TaxAmount).

columns.name: net_amount
columns.description: Net amount of journal line. This will be a positive value for a debit and negative for a credit

columns.name: tax_amount
columns.description: Total tax on a journal line

columns.name: tax_name
columns.description: The name of the tax rate.

columns.name: tax_type
columns.description: The type of the tax rate.

columns.name: account_class
columns.description: The class of account, e.g. ASSET, EQUITY, EXPENSE, LIABILITY, REVENUE

columns.name: invoice_id
columns.description: Source ID where it can be joined to the invoice table. Set to the source id of the journal when the source type of the journal is in ('ACCPAY', 'ACCREC').

columns.name: bank_transaction_id
columns.description: Source ID where it can be joined to the bank transaction table. Set to the source id of the journal when the source type of the journal is in ('CASHREC','CASHPAID').

columns.name: bank_transfer_id
columns.description: Source ID where it can be joined to the bank transfer table. Set to the source id of the journal when the source type of the journal is in ('TRANSFER').

columns.name: manual_journal_id
columns.description: Source ID where it can be joined to the manual journal table. Set to the source id of the journal when the source type of the journal is in ('MANJOURNAL').

columns.name: payment_id
columns.description: Source ID where it can be joined to the payment table. Set to the source id of the journal when the source type of the journal is in ('APPREPAYMENT', 'APOVERPAYMENT', 'ACCPAYPAYMENT', 'ACCRECPAYMENT', 'ARCREDITPAYMENT', 'APCREDITPAYMENT').

columns.name: credit_note_id
columns.description: Source ID where it can be joined to the credit note table. Set to the source id of the journal when the source type of the journal is in ('ACCPAYCREDIT','ACCRECCREDIT').

columns.name: contact_id
columns.description: ID of the associated contact, where relevant.  Populated only when source_type IN ('ACCPAY','ACCREC'); NULL otherwise

columns.name: contact_name
columns.description: Name of the contact identified by contact_id. NULL when contact_id is NULL.

  config:
    connection_string: mongodb://elt-mongodb:27017/?directConnection=true
    database: xero
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append

    - account
    - contact
postgres:
  config:
    database: xero
    host: elt-postgres
    password: testelt
    port: 5432
    schema: public
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append

    - bank_transaction
    - invoice
    user: postgres
redshift:

    host: <redshift_hostname>
    port: <redshift_port>
    database: <redshift_db>
    username: <redshift_username>
    password: <redshift_pwd>

    s3_bucket_name: <redshift_s3_bucket>
    s3_bucket_region: <redshift_s3_region>
    access_key_id: <redshift_s3_access_key>
    secret_access_key: <redshift_s3_secret_key>
